notes: Hand-seeded from the SGLang server-arguments documentation. mem-fraction-static and the attention backend are derived from the model and GPU at startup, so their defaults are null here and an explicit value always survives into the fingerprint.

params.name: model-path
params.help: Hugging Face id or local path. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: tp-size
params.help: Tensor parallel size.

params.name: dp-size
params.help: Data parallel size.

params.name: ep-size
params.help: Expert parallel size for MoE models.

params.name: enable-dp-attention
params.help: Data-parallel attention; helps MLA models at high concurrency.

params.name: mem-fraction-static
params.help: Fraction of device memory reserved for weights and the KV pool. SGLang derives a default from the model and the GPU, so there is no fixed value.

params.name: context-length
params.help: Advertised context length; defaults to the model's own.

params.name: max-total-tokens
params.help: Hard cap on KV pool tokens.

params.name: max-running-requests
params.help: Maximum concurrent running requests.

params.name: max-prefill-tokens
params.help: Token budget for one prefill batch.

params.name: chunked-prefill-size
params.help: Prefill chunk size; -1 disables chunking.

params.name: schedule-policy
params.help: Request scheduling policy. lpm prioritises longest prefix match.

params.name: schedule-conservativeness
params.help: Lower values admit more requests and risk more preemption.

params.name: stream-interval
params.help: Tokens between streaming chunks. Affects measured ITL.

params.name: disable-radix-cache
params.help: Turn off RadixAttention prefix reuse — SGLang's main advantage, so this flag is usually a mistake outside A/B tests.

params.name: page-size
params.help: KV cache page size in tokens.

params.name: kv-cache-dtype
params.help: KV cache element type.

params.name: quantization
params.help: Quantization method; usually inferred from the checkpoint.

params.name: dtype
params.help: Activation dtype.

params.name: speculative-algorithm
params.help: Speculative decoding algorithm.

params.name: speculative-num-steps
params.help: Draft steps per verification pass.

params.name: speculative-eagle-topk
params.help: Top-k draft tokens kept per step.

params.name: speculative-num-draft-tokens
params.help: Draft tokens verified per pass.

params.name: speculative-draft-model-path
params.help: Draft model for standalone speculative decoding.

params.name: attention-backend
params.help: Attention kernel backend. The default depends on the GPU and the model.

params.name: sampling-backend
params.help: Sampling kernel backend.

params.name: enable-torch-compile
params.help: torch.compile the model. Long warmup, real decode gains at small batch sizes.

params.name: torch-compile-max-bs
params.help: Largest batch size compiled.

params.name: disable-cuda-graph
params.help: Disable CUDA graph capture.

params.name: cuda-graph-max-bs
params.help: Largest batch size captured as a CUDA graph.

params.name: enable-mixed-chunk
params.help: Mix prefill chunks and decode in one batch.

params.name: grammar-backend
params.help: Constrained decoding backend.

params.name: random-seed
params.help: Random seed.

params.name: tool-call-parser
params.help: Tool call parser.

params.name: reasoning-parser
params.help: Reasoning content parser.

params.name: trust-remote-code
params.help: Execute modelling code from the weights repo.

params.name: watchdog-timeout
params.help: Seconds before the watchdog kills a stuck forward pass.

params.name: host
params.help: Bind address. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: port
params.help: Bind port. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: api-key
params.help: Required API key. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: log-level
params.help: Log level. Dropped from the fingerprint.
